# Local face landmark model

The tiny 68-point landmark model is vendored from `@vladmandic/face-api` version `1.7.15`, matching the existing browser library. It is used only for approximate enrollment pose guidance.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@vladmandic/face-api/-/face-api-1.7.15.tgz

Package SHA-512 (base64): `WDMmK3CfNLo8jylWqMoQgf4nIst3M0fzx1dnac96wv/dvMTN4DxC/Pq1DGtduDk1lktCamQ3MIDXFnvrdHTXDw==`

The package integrity was verified before extracting the manifest and its referenced binary. The package MIT license is retained in `LICENSE`. Models load from the local app; no participant images are sent to the package host.

- `face_landmark_68_tiny_model-weights_manifest.json`: SHA-256 `9a1a5dd19fd814fd5095c3cb58f8e0d3193b8c5b9a6715b30a69d559aea31ad4`
- `face_landmark_68_tiny_model.bin`: SHA-256 `b98e9f2f7da76f8a6dda9741a36ed485b224b889d552de2b2c1bb16217f67bfc`
